##1. General

The current policy describes how  Ltd ( "TETRAEDAR" , "Company") processes the personal data of the visitors of Tetraedar.com, the persons who send requests and their clients. The processing shall be carried out in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR), the Personal Data Protection Act and the applicable legislation.

The examination of the website does not require the registration or provision of personal data by the visitor. However, technical data may be processed when accessing the site.

## 2. Personal data controller

**

* Location and address of management: Production base - APK Top Stara Zagora 6001 Bulgaria
* Email: [info@Tetraedar.com](mailto:info@Tetraedar.com)
* Phone: 0887 310 476

## 3. Categories of personal data

When e-mail requests we can process name, email address, phone, message content and other voluntary data provided.

For orders, delivery, installation and service we can process names, contact details, service execution address, order details and billing information. The U.N.N.N.N. shall only be processed where there is a real need and there is an applicable legal basis.

When using the site, IP address, browser and device information, date and time of access and technical records may be processed depending on the infrastructure used.

## 4. Objectives and legal bases

* **Answer of inquiries and preparation of offers:* legitimate interest (Art. 6, par. 1, b.  "e " GDPR) or actions prior to the conclusion of a contract (b.
* **Execution of orders and contracts:** Art. 6, par. 1, b.
* **Accounting and tax liabilities:** Art. 6, par. 1, b.
* **Technical security of the website:*** legitimate interest where applicable.

##5 Email requests

Visitors may send inquiries to the email address indicated. The personal data received shall be used to examine the request, respond, provide information on products and services and subsequent communication. Sending an inquiry in itself does not mean consent to receive advertising messages.

##6. Principles of processing

We respect the principles of legality, fairness and transparency, limitation of objectives, minimization, accuracy, restriction of storage, integrity and confidentiality and accountability.

##7 Storage periods

Data shall be stored only insofar as necessary for the purpose or for the fulfilment of legal obligations.

## 8. Recipients and suppliers

We don't sell personal data. Where necessary, data may be processed by hosting providers, e-mails, technical support, accounting and courier services, and provided to competent authorities where the law so requires. For processors on our behalf, the necessary contractual and organisational guarantees shall apply.

##9 Transmission of non-EEA data

Where used suppliers suggest the transfer of personal data outside the European Economic Area, the necessary guarantees under the GDPR shall apply.

## 10. Cookies and technologies

The website may use strictly necessary cookies or similar operating and security technologies. Optional analytical or advertising technologies require consent where applicable.

## 11. Your rights

Under the conditions of GDPR you are entitled to information and access to your data, correction, deletion, restriction of processing, portability and objection. When processing is based on consent, you may withdraw it at any time without prejudice to previous lawful processing. Under applicable conditions you also have rights in relation to decisions based solely on automated processing.

## 12. Exercise of the rights

To exercise your rights, send a request to [info@Tetraedar.com](mailto:info@Tetraedar.com). We respond without undue delay, as a rule within one month. Under the conditions provided for in GDPR, the period may be extended by another two months, which you will be notified of. Requests shall as a rule be considered free of charge.

## 13. Right of appeal

If you believe that your rights have been violated, you can file a complaint with [the Personal Data Protection Commission](https://www.cpdp.bg), Sofia 1592, 2 Prof. Tsvetan Lazarov Blvd., and seek judicial protection.

## 14. Security

We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to limit the risk of unauthorised access, loss, unauthorised disclosure, modification or destruction of personal data.

## 15. Policy changes

This policy may be updated upon changes in legislation, technology used or processing activities. The current version shall be published on this page.

The mechanical locks are reliable locking mechanisms designed to ensure a high level of security and protection of safes, vaults and other valuable storage facilities. They are distinguished by their robust construction, precision craftsmanship and long-term exploitation, providing effective protection against unauthorised access.

The main advantage of mechanical locks is their independence from electronic components and external power supply. Depending on the specific model, locking and unlocking are performed by means of a mechanical key or code combination, making them a practical and reliable solution for different applications.

In our catalogue you will find mechanical locks from established manufacturers such as Dormakaba, AGA and WITTKOPP, offering high quality locking systems for professional use.

The available models are suitable for different types of safes, vault doors and secure facilities. The choice of a suitable mechanical lock depends on the security requirements, the construction of the safe, the method of locking and the required level of protection.
